snapshot.title: Phone Call: City IT Director — Business Network Isolation

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Kevin Marsh
transcript.text: Priya, it's Kevin. I'm on the business LAN. The domain controllers, MBW-DC-01 and MBW-DC-02, are unreachable. Active Directory is failing across the board.

transcript.speaker: Kevin Marsh
transcript.text: The ransomware has encrypted MBW-CIS-01, MBW-AMI-01, and MBW-FS-01. I’ve just seen the ransom note on a control room desktop: 'Pay $2.4M in Bitcoin or lose your water.'

transcript.speaker: Kevin Marsh
transcript.text: The file server is down. The backup, MBW-BKP-01, is not mounting. We’ve pulled the network cable. The business network is now physically isolated.

transcript.speaker: Kevin Marsh
transcript.text: The lab cannot process new samples. I need to know if we can still run the plant manually — and if the control network is still clean.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Understood, Kevin. I’ve confirmed the control network remains isolated from the business LAN. No traffic from MBW-CIS-01 to MBW-SCADA-SRV01 has been observed on the firewall.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: We’re still in the process of verifying the integrity of the SCADA DMZ. I’ve initiated a full network audit on MBW-FW-01. I’ll notify you if any unauthorized session is detected.

transcript.speaker: Kevin Marsh
transcript.text: Good. The lab’s LIMS is down. We can’t file new results. The public can’t access outage maps. I’m not getting any updates from customer service. We need to activate unified command now.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Roger. I’ll confirm with the Director. We’re at Level 3 emergency. I’ll initiate the unified command structure per ERP Section 4.

transcript.speaker: Kevin Marsh
transcript.text: Copy that. I’ll keep you posted on the business side. Let’s keep the plant running on manual control until we’re sure.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Affirmative. I’ll update the Incident Commander immediately.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the business network is fully isolated and the control network remains intact. The IT Director confirms the ransomware has encrypted key systems, triggering the need to activate unified command under ERP Section 4. Watch for the Director to declare Level 3 emergency and invoke Section 10.3 if manual control is not already assumed.
